description: Returns how outage calls are set up in the project: whether calls are on (`is_enabled`), after how many seconds of downtime the call is placed (`delay`: 0, 120, 300 or 600 — shorter outages produce no call), and which monitors trigger it (`server_scope`: `all` — every monitor of the project including ones added later, `selected` — only `server_ids`; an empty `server_ids` with `selected` means no calls). Phones are not here: a call goes to confirmed phones switched on in the project (`type: phone` in `project_channel_list`). A call also needs calls left on the balance, see `call_balance_get`. Only outages are called about, not recoveries.
name: project_voice_calls_get
title: Get outage call settings of a project
